content: If J1939Tp Tx RetrySupport is disabled, when the J1939Tp receives a TP.CM_CTS frame requesting already sent data, it shall abort the transmission using the mechanisms described by SWS_J1939Tp_ 00032 and SWS_J1939Tp_ 00097 with reason 25 5 ( unassigned ).
